summary: Identifies the source and client timing points included in the defined synchronization assessment.
description: Identifies the source and client timing points included in the defined synchronization assessment. A station time system provides a shared time reference for protection records, measurements and automation. Different devices can use different timing protocols, so the time source, distribution path and quality information must remain identifiable.

In a substation, a station clock can provide precision timing to process equipment and another timing interface to event recorders. The alarm system should distinguish loss of a distribution path from loss of the external time source. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reference and client timing points” at the input and “Timing comparison information” at the output. The drawing does not establish measured timing performance.
